review_preservation_contract.rule: Capture current target and trustworthy reference before any panel-content correction. Do not reconstruct quotes/images from memory or attachment IDs alone.

lowest_common_ancestor_method.hero: Find nearest section-scale stable common ancestor of full source-equivalent hero copy and .elementor-element-af2e004e without swallowing following sections.
lowest_common_ancestor_method.gallery: Find nearest section-scale stable common ancestor of exact Sövénymunkák heading and .elementor-element-b2e2c001; b2e2c001 alone is insufficient if heading is outside.
lowest_common_ancestor_method.form: Find nearest section-scale stable common ancestor of .elementor-element-af2e004c and .mf-form-wrapper[data-form-id=33] without unrelated neighboring sections.
lowest_common_ancestor_method.rule: Do not accept page/main/root merely because it contains both nodes.
